snippet.title: On Point Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
On Point finally hits 1.0 with this massive release, including:
- Rebuilt unlocks, ticket-based progression system.
- Per-mini-game rankings.
- 115 fully playable minigames. 
- Marathon Mode, One-Off Minigames, and Hard Mode.
- Overhauled UI with real-time stat tracking.

Available now on:
- Meta: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/on-point/6147966358583353/
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296750/On_Point/
